verdict.statement: Classical-frame and force-clock limits are enforced. The unchanged SPICE ITRF93 limit remains a recorded reference-spread miss. Untoleranced rows measure documented model choices.

measurement.units: angles mas; position differences/bounds metres; rates m/s
measurement.epochs: 50 UTC hourly samples; exact TT/UT1; rates diagnostic spans 1990–2040
measurement.toleranceRationale: Precession 0.001 mas; classical ERFA identity 1e-7 mas (matrix rounding, <0.021 micrometre at GEO); CIO 0.022 mas includes 0.02 mas hourly CIP interpolation; kernel reads 1 mm. Model-spread rows are diagnostic, limits are not widened.

e2e.replay: Rebuild HPOP against final sources and rescore all 50 epochs against pinned reference.json in C++; assert four classical rows, c2tTrue and SGP4 TEME limits.
